flashOnDamage.name: Flash on Damage/Healing
flashOnDamage.hint: Flash the token ring red on damage and green on healing.

ringColorSource.name: Ring Color Source
ringColorSource.hint: Which resource determines the ring's color gradient.

showOnHover.name: Show on Hover Only
showOnHover.hint: Hide the health arc and ring color until the mouse hovers over the token.

lowThreshold.name: Low Threshold (%)
lowThreshold.hint: Below this percentage the ring turns red.

midThreshold.name: Mid Threshold (%)
midThreshold.hint: Below this percentage the ring turns yellow.
